name: rayvoice
title: RayVoice
description: Turn the text on your clipboard into a narrated episode or a two-host podcast with ElevenLabs.
author: francesco_oddo

commands.name: clipboard-speech
commands.title: Speak Clipboard as Podcast
commands.description: Read the clipboard aloud in one voice. Playback starts as soon as the first sentences are voiced.

commands.name: clipboard-podcast
commands.title: Clipboard to 2-Host Podcast
commands.description: Turn the clipboard into a conversation between two hosts with ElevenLabs Text-to-Dialogue.

commands.name: intro
commands.title: Play Welcome Intro
commands.description: A short spoken tour of RayVoice. Voiced once, then replayed from cache.

commands.name: history
commands.title: Browse Past Episodes
commands.description: Replay, search, and manage every episode and transcript.

preferences.name: voiceId
preferences.title: Voice ID (Host 1 / Narrator)
preferences.description: Any voice ID from elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library. Default is Rachel.

preferences.name: voiceId2
preferences.title: Voice ID (Host 2, dialogue only)
preferences.description: Second voice for the 2-host podcast. Default is George.

preferences.name: modelId
preferences.title: ElevenLabs Model
preferences.description: Turbo starts fastest. Text-to-Dialogue uses Turbo when Flash or Multilingual is picked.

preferences.name: outputFormat
preferences.title: Audio Format
preferences.description: 128 kbps sounds best. Lower bitrates make smaller files.

preferences.name: autoPlay
preferences.title: Playback
preferences.description: Start playing as soon as the first part is ready.
preferences.label: Auto-play audio

preferences.name: playbackRate
preferences.title: Playback Speed
preferences.description: Starting speed. Change it while listening with ⌘S.
